save_the_cat.title: Save the Cat! Beat Sheet
save_the_cat.description: A popular 15-beat structure for commercial storytelling.
save_the_cat.opening_image_desc: A visual that represents the struggle & tone of the story.
save_the_cat.theme_stated_desc: A statement made by a character that hints at what the story is about.
save_the_cat.setup_desc: An exploration of the hero's world and what needs to change.
save_the_cat.catalyst_desc: An event that pushes the hero into a new world or situation.
save_the_cat.debate_desc: The hero's hesitation to take up the challenge.
save_the_cat.break_into_two_desc: The hero decides to accept the challenge.
save_the_cat.b_story_desc: A subplot that helps to explore the theme.
save_the_cat.fun_and_games_desc: The hero explores the new world and its rules.
save_the_cat.midpoint_desc: A point where the stakes are raised, and the hero's goal becomes clear.
save_the_cat.bad_guys_close_in_desc: The opposition gets stronger and applies pressure.
save_the_cat.all_is_lost_desc: The hero loses everything they gained.
save_the_cat.dark_night_of_the_soul_desc: The hero's lowest point, where they realize the truth.
save_the_cat.break_into_three_desc: The hero understands what they must do.
save_the_cat.finale_desc: The hero confronts the opposition, applying the lessons learned.
save_the_cat.final_image_desc: The opposite of the Opening Image, showing the change.

monomyth.title: The Monomyth (Hero's Journey)
monomyth.description: A classic 12-stage structure found in myths and legends worldwide.
monomyth.ordinary_world_desc: The hero's normal life before the story begins.
monomyth.call_to_adventure_desc: The hero is faced with a challenge or quest.
monomyth.refusal_of_the_call_desc: The hero is reluctant to accept the call.
monomyth.meeting_the_mentor_desc: The hero encounters a mentor to gain advice or training.
monomyth.crossing_the_threshold_desc: The hero commits to the journey and enters a new world.
monomyth.tests_allies_enemies_desc: The hero faces challenges and meets new people.
monomyth.approach_to_inmost_cave_desc: The hero prepares for the major challenge.
monomyth.ordeal_desc: The hero faces their greatest fear or a death-and-rebirth moment.
monomyth.reward_desc: The hero takes possession of the treasure they've won.
monomyth.the_road_back_desc: The hero begins their journey back to their ordinary world.
monomyth.resurrection_desc: The hero is tested one last time and purified by a last sacrifice.
monomyth.return_with_elixir_desc: The hero returns with something to benefit the ordinary world.

fools_journey.title: The Fool's Journey
fools_journey.description: A plot structure based on the Tarot's Major Arcana.
fools_journey.ordinary_world_desc: The protagonist's life before the story starts.
fools_journey.refusal_of_the_call_desc: The protagonist is hesitant to embark on the journey.
fools_journey.meeting_the_mentor_desc: The protagonist gains advice or an object of importance.
fools_journey.crossing_the_threshold_desc: The protagonist commits to the journey.
fools_journey.tests_allies_enemies_desc: The protagonist learns the rules of the new world.
fools_journey.approach_desc: The protagonist and their allies prepare for a major challenge.
fools_journey.ordeal_death_rebirth_desc: The protagonist faces their greatest fear and is forever changed by the experience.
fools_journey.reward_desc: The protagonist takes possession of a treasure.
fools_journey.the_road_back_desc: The protagonist begins their journey back to their ordinary world.
fools_journey.resurrection_desc: The protagonist is tested one last time.
fools_journey.return_with_the_elixir_desc: The protagonist returns home with something to benefit their community.

novel_30_days.title: A Novel in 30 Days
novel_30_days.description: A plot structure for writing a novel in a month.
novel_30_days.inciting_incident_desc: The event that gets the story started.
novel_30_days.first_plot_point_desc: The protagonist is pushed into the main conflict.
novel_30_days.first_pinch_point_desc: A reminder of the antagonist's power.
novel_30_days.midpoint_desc: The protagonist moves from reaction to action.
novel_30_days.second_pinch_point_desc: Another reminder of the antagonist's power.
novel_30_days.third_plot_point_desc: The protagonist is at their lowest point.
novel_30_days.resolution_desc: The story's loose ends are tied up.

truby_22.title: Truby's 22 Steps
truby_22.description: A detailed plot structure for creating a complex and layered story.
truby_22.weakness_and_need_desc: The protagonist's flaw and what they need to overcome it.
truby_22.inciting_incident_desc: The event that kicks off the story.
truby_22.opponent_and_or_mystery_desc: The antagonist and the story's central question.
truby_22.fake_ally_opponent_desc: A character who seems to be an ally but is actually an opponent.
truby_22.first_revelation_and_decision_desc: The protagonist learns something new and makes a choice.
truby_22.opponents_plan_and_main_counterattack_de: The antagonist's plan and how they strike back.
truby_22.drive_desc: The protagonist's actions to achieve their desire.
truby_22.apparent_defeat_desc: The protagonist seems to have lost.
truby_22.second_revelation_and_decision_desc: The protagonist learns something new and makes a new choice.
truby_22.audience_revelation_desc: The audience learns something the protagonist doesn't.
truby_22.third_revelation_and_decision_desc: The protagonist has a major realization.
truby_22.gate_gauntlet_visit_to_death_desc: The protagonist faces a series of obstacles.
truby_22.self_revelation_desc: The protagonist has a major realization about themself.
truby_22.moral_decision_desc: The protagonist makes a choice that shows their growth.

24_chapter_outline.title: 24 Chapter Outline
24_chapter_outline.ch19_desc: Protagonist is at their lowest point.
24_chapter_outline.ch20_desc: Protagonist has a moment of clarity.
24_chapter_outline.ch21_desc: Protagonist prepares for the final confrontation.

27_chapter_outline.title: 27 Chapter Outline
27_chapter_outline.description: A three-act plot structure broken down into 27 chapters.

story_circle.title: Story Circle
story_circle.description: Dan Harmon's 8-step structure for compelling storytelling.
story_circle.you: 1. You (A character is in a zone of comfort)
story_circle.you_desc: Establish the protagonist in their ordinary world.
story_circle.need_desc: The character has a desire or goal.
story_circle.go_desc: They cross a threshold into a new world.
story_circle.search_desc: The character faces trials and learns the rules.
story_circle.take: 6. Take (Pay a heavy price for it)
story_circle.take_desc: Achieving the goal comes at a great cost.
story_circle.return: 7. Return (They go back to their familiar situation)
story_circle.return_desc: They bring their newfound knowledge/item back home.
story_circle.change_desc: The character is transformed by the journey.

snowflake.title: The Snowflake Method
snowflake.description: A method for designing a story from a simple sentence up.
snowflake.one_sentence_desc: Write a one-sentence summary of your story. This is your high-concept pitch.
snowflake.one_paragraph_desc: Expand the sentence to a full paragraph describing the story setup, major disasters, and ending.
snowflake.character_synopses_desc: Write a one-page summary sheet for each major character, detailing their goals, conflicts, and epiphanies.
snowflake.expand_to_paragraphs_desc: Expand each sentence of your one-paragraph summary into a full paragraph. Each paragraph should end in a disaster.
snowflake.character_one_pagers_desc: Write a one-page description of the story from the perspective of each major character.
snowflake.four_page_synopsis_desc: Expand each paragraph from Step 4 into a full page.
